title: Judgment on Ammon
description: The Lord proclaims judgment against the people of Ammon because they have seized the land of Gad. Rabbah will become a heap of ruins, Milkom will go into captivity along with his priests and leaders, and the people will be driven away. Yet in the end, the Lord promises to restore the fate of Ammon. [ref:Jer 49:1-6|Jeremiah 49:1-6]
